_comment: Machine-readable provenance sidecar for simulation_config.json. The engine does NOT load this file; it exists so parameter rationale can be surfaced in docs/UI and kept in sync. Every key under `parameters` is a dotted path that exists in simulation_config.json and its `value` equals the shipped value (tests/test_config_excel_sync.py pins both); `code_constants` records rationale for values that live in code, not in the JSON. The narrative lives in MODEL_CARD.md.

economic_parameters.carbon_price_base.rationale: Conservative early-2020s compliance-market starting price (EU ETS traded broadly 50-100 EUR).

economic_parameters.carbon_price_growth_.rationale: Reflects modelled upward carbon-price path as caps tighten; rewards early decarbonisation over the 5-year horizon.

economic_parameters.circular_economy_eff.rationale: Order-of-magnitude OPEX/material-efficiency gain from circular strategies.
economic_parameters.circular_economy_eff.reference: Ellen MacArthur Foundation / ReSOLVE case evidence

financial_parameters.shadow_carbon_price.rationale: Internal carbon price for capital decisions, set above market to make long-horizon decarbonisation visible; leading corporates apply high internal prices.

financial_parameters.corporate_tax_rate.rationale: Blended statutory corporate tax rate across major economies.

financial_parameters.emergency_rate_spre.rationale: Premium charged when a firm draws crisis credit.

financial_parameters.wacc_lender_thresho.rationale: Cost-of-capital level above which lenders price in ESG-driven risk; ties Natural Capital Debt to real credit behaviour.

climate_parameters.loss_damage_levy_stre.rationale: Climate loss-and-damage liability under stressed conditions.

climate_parameters.loss_damage_levy_tipp.rationale: Step-up liability once a climate tipping point is crossed; encodes non-linearity of climate risk.

terminal_valuation.exit_multiple_floor.rationale: Floor of the dynamic (Gordon-growth) exit multiple: Derived from WACC + long-run nominal growth via Gordon Growth Model, clamped to floor/ceiling; links valuation to cost of capital. 12x is representative mid-cycle EV/EBITDA for diversified industrials.
terminal_valuation.exit_multiple_floor.reference: Gordon Growth Model; sector EV/EBITDA comps

terminal_valuation.exit_multiple_ceiling.rationale: Ceiling of the dynamic (Gordon-growth) exit multiple — the top of observed mid-cycle EV/EBITDA for diversified industrials.
terminal_valuation.exit_multiple_ceiling.reference: Gordon Growth Model; sector EV/EBITDA comps

engine_parameters.eu_taxonomy.green_thre.rationale: Share of taxonomy-aligned (low carbon-intensity) revenue above which the cost-of-capital benefit (coc_benefit) applies.

engine_parameters.eu_taxonomy.brown_thre.rationale: Share of high carbon-intensity revenue above which the cost-of-capital surcharge (coc_surcharge) applies.

terminal_valuation.calculate_mr synergy_.rationale: Reduced from 0.30 to avoid double-counting: synergy already lowers OPEX and raises EBITDA.

greenium (not implemented).rationale: Greenium for sustainability leaders on green bonds / sustainability-linked loans. Recorded as design intent only — no engine reads a greenium today.
